title: On statistics of prime parking functions, Łukasiewicz paths, and quasisymmetric functions
summary: We recall that a parking function of length $n+1$ is said to be prime if removing any instance of 1 yields a parking function of length $n$. In this article, we study prime parking functions from multiple lenses. We derive an explicit formula for the average value of the total displacement of prime parking functions. We present a formula for the displacement-enumerator of prime parking functions that involves a sum over Łukasiewicz paths.
